LogEntries.Entry: A survey crew left their samples behind at the <Alias=DungeonLocation>. A site hand there is holding them. I should go and ask him for the crate.
The site hand says the crew left in a hurry and took his crate by mistake, lunch and all. Ours is still here. He's marked where.
I've got the Goods Package. It goes to <Alias=FinalLocation> on <Alias=targetPlanet>, whenever I'm heading that way.
A survey crew left their samples at the <Alias=DungeonLocation> and took a site hand's lunch by mistake. I collected the samples and delivered them to the <Alias=FinalLocation>.

Objectives.DisplayText: Talk to the site hand at the <Alias=DungeonLocation>
Deliver the survey crate to the <Alias=FinalLocation>

Lines.ResponseText: You're from the survey lot? Good. I've had their crate here for days and I've been told not to open it.
I'm here for the survey crate.
Right. Your crew left in a hurry and took the wrong crate.
Theirs had my lunch in it. Yours is still here. I've marked it for you.
How long have you been out here?
Eleven years, on and off.
Most weeks nobody comes out at all. You're the third this week. It's been a big week.
Why did the crew leave?
A recall came in from their office and they were packed in an hour. Nothing bad. They were nice enough. Loud, but nice.
Did you look inside?
No. It says sealed, so it's sealed.
I did shake it once. It rattles like rocks. Which I suppose it is.
What was in your lunch?
Two rolls and a pickled egg.
Somebody on that crew is having a very confusing afternoon.
Do you like it out here?
I like it fine. The quiet doesn't ask me anything.
Present company excepted. You can ask.
Visitor! Hang on, let me put this down.
Another one! It's been a very busy week.
